films.en: Pokémon the Movie: Secrets of the Jungle
where: Netflix India (Hindi audio, Oct 2021 – c. Sep 2023; now removed)
Indian theatres (special screenings Feb 2024 and Oct 2024; language not confirmed)
films.note: Hindi title: 'Jungle Ka Raaz'. Premiered on Netflix India on 8 Oct 2021 with a Hindi dub (Bulbapedia; ANN mentions a Hindi trailer). On 2026-11-19 the Netflix India page said the title isn't available in India, and it is not on JioHotstar. Classed as 'aired' because the Hindi dub was released but no current legal stream exists. The Feb 2024 PVR Mumbai screening was English only; the Oct 2024 10-city screenings: https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/news/2024-10-10/pokemon-the-movie-secrets-of-the-jungle-anime-film-gets-theatrical-screening-in-india-on-october-20/.216542
